title: Late Arrivals
statement: A list of arrival times in minutes past the hour is already in the file. Fill in `late_arrivals` so it returns the names of everyone who arrived after minute 5, in the order they appear, and `main` prints them one per line. Nothing else changes.

files.name: late_arrivals.py

rubric: Only arrivals after minute 5 are returned, so Alan at exactly 5 is not late.
The original order is preserved and the names are returned, not the whole records.
A list of names is returned rather than printed from inside the function, so main still does the printing.
The sample data and main are left as they are.
curveballs: Actually, count minute 5 as late too.
Print how many were late on the last line.
Return them in alphabetical order instead.
